timestamps.last_committed: set to current observed time after atomic commit; do not accumulate discarded time
timestamps.clock_backward: no reward; record anomaly; preserve high-water timestamp
timestamps.idempotency: unique event_id; transaction writes rewards and event IDs together

territory.capture: one deployment team at a time; must be adjacent discovered region; win all defending teams in order; home territory protected from transfer
territory.extraction: requires owner and building/crew rule, accrue each 60s tick, capped by stock capacity
territory.travel: route shortest path by travel seconds, explicit departure and arrival event
territory.npc_rules: stock shortfall -> buy -> trade, defend threatened regions, explore/claim neutral, declare war below relation threshold; max one major action per faction per 600s tick

raids.resolve_offline: same deterministic encounter resolver; player defense roster saved; no interactive requirement while offline

team_assignment: ninja can keep production job while fighting; only one deployed team per owned template; no upkeep; no unlimited loops per tick
battle_stalemate_offline: if resolver reaches 120 seconds no effective progress, resolve as no conquest/no loot; manual battle continues or player withdraws
